item.text: {"search_note":"I did not find credible 2024 evidence that Sisi protected independent media, reduced ownership pressure, or created stronger safeguards for information access. I also did not find a substantive anti-propaganda reform or a clear rollback of censorship. The only positive material is narrow and mostly indirect, so the overall reading remains negative.","evidence":[{"title":"Egypt: Spate of Free Speech Prosecutions","publisher":"Human Rights Watch","date":"2024-08-29","url":"https://www.hrw.org/news/2024/08/29/egypt-spate-free-speech-prosecutions","summary":"HRW said authorities renewed prosecutions of critics, including satirist Ashraf Omar, and that mainstream media remained severely curtailed. This is direct evidence against protecting independent media.","question_ids":["4B.6","4B.3","4B.5"]},{"title":"Egypt | World Report 2024","publisher":"Human Rights Watch","date":"2024","url":"https://www.hrw.org/world-report/2024/country-chapters/egypt","summary":"HRW reported that prosecutors referred three Mada Masr journalists to trial over reporting tied to a corruption investigation, while activists, journalists, and protesters continued facing broad security charges. This is strong evidence of pressure on journalists and a hostile information environment.","question_ids":["4B.6","4B.3","4B.5"]},{"title":"Egypt: Halt crackdown on people voicing concerns over economic crisis","publisher":"Amnesty International","date":"2024-05-13","url":"https://www.amnesty.org/en/latest/news/2024/05/egypt-halt-crackdown-on-people-voicing-concerns-over-economic-crisis/","summary":"Amnesty documented arrests of protesters, striking workers, and online critics over economic commentary, plus dispersal of a protest and failure to properly investigate abuse complaints. This shows the state suppressing unfavorable information and criticism rather than protecting it.","question_ids":["4B.6","4B.3","4B.5"]},{"title":"Egypt: More than 100 arbitrarily detained over calls for anti-government protests","publisher":"Amnesty International","date":"2024-07-18","url":"https://www.amnesty.org/en/latest/news/2024/07/egypt-more-than-100-arbitrarily-detained-over-calls-for-anti-government-protests/","summary":"Amnesty said security forces detained 119 people after online protest calls, used incommunicado detention, and charged people under broad security offenses. That is evidence of coercive pressure on information-sharing and public dissent.","question_ids":["4B.6","4B.3","4B.5"]},{"title":"Egypt: Release protesters and activists detained over Palestine solidarity","publisher":"Amnesty International","date":"2024-06-14","url":"https://www.amnesty.org/en/latest/news/2024/06/egypt-release-protesters-and-activists-detained-over-palestine-solidarity/","summary":"Amnesty reported arrests of protesters, human-rights defenders, journalists, and lawyers over a peaceful solidarity action. This is direct evidence against tolerance of open information exchange and protest.","question_ids":["4B.6","4B.3","4B.5"]},{"title":"Egypt's presidential elections were held in a fair and secure climate: SIS report","publisher":"State Information Service","date":"2024-01","url":"https://sis.gov.eg/en/media-center/news/egypt-s-presidential-elections-were-held-in-a-fair-and-secure-climate-sis-report/","summary":"The state’s own media framed the election as fair, secure, and internationally observed. It is relevant mainly as a propaganda-style state claim, not as proof of open information access.","question_ids":["4B.6","4B.2","4B.5"]},{"title":"Human Rights Watch submission to the Universal Periodic Review of Egypt","publisher":"Human Rights Watch","date":"2024-07-15","url":"https://www.hrw.org/news/2024/07/15/human-rights-watch-submission-universal-periodic-review-egypt","summary":"HRW said some travel bans were gradually lifted and Case 173 was announced closed, but asset freezes and terrorism charges persisted for several activists. This is the closest thing I found to a partial positive, but it is about limited civic access, not a meaningful opening for independent media.","question_ids":["4B.6","4B.3","4B.5"]}]}
